title: Human Practices & Regulation
blurb: The engagements that changed ReLeaf's design, the farm and company visits, the 5 September forum and booth, biosafety and containment, and the regulatory route a contained on-farm GMO bioreactor would need in Taiwan.
blurb_zh: 改變 ReLeaf 設計的各項交流、農場與企業參訪、9 月 5 日的公眾論壇與攤位活動、生物安全與圍阻，以及一台田間密閉式基因改造生物反應器在台灣真正需要走的法規路徑。

questions.q: How many stakeholders did you engage, over what period, and across which domains?
questions.q_zh: 你們總共接觸了多少位利害關係人、時間跨度多長、涵蓋哪些領域？
questions.answer: Twenty key stakeholders over seven months, March to September 2026, across six domains: deployment and human practices, plant and stress biology, protectant design, gene circuit and cloning, bioreactor and hardware, and mathematical modeling. The twenty are not twenty academics: they include farmers, two companies (CH Biotech and Yes Health iFarm), the World Vegetable Center, a farming cooperative and two trade exhibitions. The pipelines on the Integrated Human Practices page carry each conversation with its date and what we changed.
questions.answer_zh: 七個月內共 20 位關鍵利害關係人，自 2026 年 3 月至 9 月，涵蓋六個領域：落地應用與人文實踐、植物與逆境生物學、保護劑設計、基因迴路與選殖、生物反應器與硬體、數學建模。這 20 位並非 20 位學者，其中包含農友、兩家公司（正瀚生技與源鮮智慧農場）、世界蔬菜中心、一個友善耕作合作社，以及兩場產業展覽。人文實踐頁的 pipeline 逐筆列出每次對談的日期與我們因此做出的改變。
questions.trap: Saying "20 experts" or "20 interviews" — several of the twenty are organisations or exhibitions, not individual interviews.
questions.trap_zh: 回答「20 位專家」或「20 場訪談」——其中數項是機構或展覽，不是個別訪談。

questions.q: You started out releasing engineered bacteria into soil and ended with a sealed bioreactor. Who told you to change, and what exactly did they say?
questions.q_zh: 你們一開始打算把工程菌釋放到土壤，最後變成密閉生物反應器。是誰讓你們改變的？他們具體說了什麼？
questions.answer: Two April conversations did it. On 10 April Prof. Chen Wen-Liang (陳文亮), founder of Agritalk, told us to treat the hardware as the printer and the biofertilizer as the ink, pointed out the problems of open-soil release, and told us to define a clear input-output mapping; we abandoned direct soil release and moved to a controlled bioreactor. On 18 April Dr. Jennifer Brophy told us physical containment should be the primary safety mechanism rather than relying only on a kill switch, and to design a semi-permeable membrane that retains bacteria while letting the protectants diffuse out. That membrane is the hollow-fiber cartridge we built.
questions.answer_zh: 是四月的兩場對談促成的。4 月 10 日，Agritalk 創辦人陳文亮教授告訴我們把硬體當作印表機、把生物肥料當作墨水，指出土壤開放釋放的問題，並要我們定義清楚的輸入—輸出對應關係；我們因此放棄直接土壤釋放，轉向受控的生物反應器。4 月 18 日，Dr. Jennifer Brophy 告訴我們物理圍阻 (physical containment) 應該是主要的安全機制，而不是只依賴自殺開關 (kill switch)，並建議設計一層半透膜，留住細菌而讓保護劑擴散出去。那層膜就是我們後來做的中空纖維模組。
questions.trap: Crediting the pivot to the team's own biosafety reasoning. The wiki attributes it to named experts on specific dates — use the names.
questions.trap_zh: 把這個轉向說成是團隊自己的生物安全判斷。wiki 把它歸給特定日期的具名專家——請直接講出名字。

questions.q: What exactly keeps the engineered B. subtilis inside the machine, and where does that barrier stop working?
questions.q_zh: 究竟是什麼把工程化的枯草桿菌留在機器裡？這道屏障在什麼情況下就不成立了？
questions.answer: Primary containment is a PES hollow-fiber cartridge with a 0.2 µm nominal pore, which the Safety page argues is below the 0.5 to 1.0 µm diameter of a B. subtilis cell. Secondary containment is three detectors: transmembrane-pressure leak detection, droplet leak detection and shell-side turbidity for escaped cells. The barrier is only a cell-scale barrier: Results notes a 0.2 µm microfiltration membrane still passes debris and vesicles in the 20 to 200 nm range along with the protein. It also only covers the membrane: Measurement states the tubing, connectors and pump head are part of the containment boundary and no instrument watches them, and version 1 of the reactor ended early when medium leaked at the pump head, which carries lumen-side culture.
questions.answer_zh: 主要圍阻是一組 PES 中空纖維模組，標稱孔徑 0.2 µm，安全頁指出這小於枯草桿菌 0.5 至 1.0 µm 的菌體直徑。次級圍阻是三個偵測器：跨膜壓力 (TMP) 洩漏偵測、液滴洩漏偵測，以及監測逃逸細胞的殼側濁度計。這道屏障只是「細胞尺度」的屏障：Results 頁指出 0.2 µm 微過濾膜仍會讓 20 至 200 nm 的碎片與囊泡隨蛋白一起通過。它也只涵蓋膜本身：Measurement 頁明寫管路、接頭與蠕動泵頭同樣屬於圍阻邊界，而目前沒有任何儀器在看它們；反應器第一版就是因為泵頭處培養液外漏而提前中止，而泵頭管路走的是管內側（lumen）的菌液。
questions.trap: Quoting the pore size as proof of containment and stopping there. The pump head, tubing and connectors are the unwatched part of the same boundary.
questions.trap_zh: 只引孔徑當作圍阻的證明就結束。泵頭、管路與接頭是同一道邊界上沒人監看的部分。

questions.q: Your Safety page says no test of the containment is reported, yet its Figure 1 claims complete cell rejection. Which is it, and what does your own record say about leakage?
questions.q_zh: 你們的安全頁說頁面上沒有回報任何圍阻測試，但它的圖 1 卻聲稱完全阻留細胞。到底是哪一個？你們自己的紀錄怎麼寫洩漏這件事？
questions.answer: Both statements are on the page and they do not sit well together. The Safety and Security award box answers "Is their contribution well-characterised and/or well-validated?" with "Not on this page yet. No test of the containment is reported here," while Figure 1 on the same page describes shell-side medium after 24 h as showing complete cell rejection with no colony. Results is the honest version: two platings are the entire containment record, one of them from the version 1 run that stopped early when medium leaked at the pump, no log reduction value was measured, there is no replicate within a run, and for the June plate the incubation time and temperature were not recorded. Separately, our own Human Practices record of Prof. Chang's 4 September visit says B. subtilis and protectant were leaking out of the hollow-fiber membrane even without any driving force. We should present containment as designed and once spot-checked, not as validated.
questions.answer_zh: 兩種說法都在同一頁上，而且彼此不太相容。安全與保全獎項的對照框在回答「貢獻是否經過良好表徵或驗證？」時寫的是「本頁尚無。此處未回報任何圍阻測試」；但同一頁的圖 1 卻描述 24 小時後的殼側培養液完全阻留細胞、無菌落生成。Results 頁是比較誠實的版本：整個專案的圍阻紀錄只有兩次塗盤，其中一次來自因泵頭漏液而提前中止的第一版運轉，沒有測得對數削減值 (log reduction)，單次運轉內沒有重複，六月那盤的培養時間與溫度也沒有記錄。另外，我們自己在人文實踐頁記下張嘉修教授 9 月 4 日來訪時的內容：即使沒有任何驅動力，枯草桿菌與保護劑仍從中空纖維膜漏出。我們應該把圍阻陳述為「已設計、曾抽查一次」，而不是「已驗證」。
questions.trap: Repeating "complete cell rejection" from the figure caption. A judge who has read Results and the 4 September note will catch it immediately.
questions.trap_zh: 照著圖說重述「完全阻留細胞」。讀過 Results 頁與 9 月 4 日紀錄的評審會立刻抓到。

questions.q: Tell me about the public forum: its name, date, venue, host, size and speakers.
questions.q_zh: 請說明這場公眾論壇：名稱、日期、地點、主辦方、規模與講者。
questions.answer: "Field Dialogue: Agricultural Solutions to Climate Change", held on the morning of 5 September 2026 at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market, hosted by Green Media (綠媒體), with more than 50 participants. Three speakers shared first: Prof. Chen on smart agriculture, Dr. Li on natural farming, and a researcher from CH Biotech on biostimulants. We then presented ReLeaf and the bioreactor, and closed with a farmers' feedback session. Green Media published an article on the forum afterwards.
questions.answer_zh: 論壇名為「田間對話：氣候變遷的農業解方」，2026 年 9 月 5 日上午在台北水花園有機農夫市集舉行，由綠媒體主辦，超過 50 人參與。首先由三位講者分享：陳教授談智慧農業、李博士談自然農法、正瀚生技的研究員談生物刺激素 (biostimulant)。接著我們介紹 ReLeaf 與生物反應器，最後安排農友回饋的環節。綠媒體事後刊出了一篇報導該場論壇的文章。
questions.trap: Saying 6 September. Our own Farmer engagement section says 6 September while every other mention, including the photo captions and the Sustainability page, says 5 September.
questions.trap_zh: 回答 9 月 6 日。我們自己的農友交流段落寫 9 月 6 日，但其他所有提及（包含照片說明與永續頁）都是 9 月 5 日。

questions.q: Why is there no kill switch? If a Taiwanese regulator asked for one, what would you say?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼沒有自殺開關 (kill switch)？如果台灣的主管機關要求你們加上，你們會怎麼回答？
questions.answer: A kill switch was our original plan and two consultations moved us off it. On 19 March Dr. Lin raised considering not doing a kill switch; on 18 April Dr. Brophy said physical containment should be the primary safety mechanism rather than relying only on a kill switch, and highlighted several potential problems with the kill-switch design, after which we began treating physical containment as primary and listed "evaluate whether an additional kill switch is necessary" as the open action. Nothing on the wiki records that evaluation closing, and the Safety page describes no genetic containment at all. If a regulator asked, our honest answer is that we have a physical containment argument with one spot-check behind it and no genetic backup, and that the Laws page already commits us to seeking a written determination from the authority before commercial manufacture.
questions.answer_zh: 自殺開關原本是我們的設計，兩次諮詢讓我們放棄它。3 月 19 日林博士提出「考慮不做自殺開關」；4 月 18 日 Dr. Brophy 表示物理圍阻應為主要安全機制，而非只依賴自殺開關，並指出自殺開關設計的幾個潛在問題，之後我們開始把物理圍阻當作主要手段，並把「評估是否仍需額外的自殺開關」列為待辦。wiki 上沒有任何紀錄顯示這項評估已經結案，安全頁也完全沒有描述任何基因層面的圍阻。若主管機關詢問，我們誠實的答案是：我們有一套物理圍阻的論證、背後只有一次抽查，沒有基因備援；而法規頁已經承諾在商業化製造前先取得主管機關的書面認定。
questions.trap: Claiming a CRISPR kill switch exists. The Entrepreneurship page says that, and no other page supports it.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱已有 CRISPR 自殺開關。只有商業化頁這麼寫，其他頁面都沒有支持。

questions.q: Dr. Lin told you to consider hydroponics on 19 March and Prof. Cheng told you to avoid relying on it eight days later. How did you decide, and what did you lose?
questions.q_zh: 3 月 19 日林博士建議你們考慮水耕，八天後鄭教授卻叫你們不要依賴水耕。你們怎麼做決定？又失去了什麼？
questions.answer: We followed Prof. Cheng. On 27 March she said hydroponics might not be stable for our testing and that we should prioritise agar-plate growth for early-stage control followed by careful transfer to soil, and she gave us Arabidopsis seeds; we adopted a plate-to-soil transition model, stopped relying on hydroponics as the main experimental system, and dropped osmotic stress from our target stresses to remove a confounding variable. We did not abandon hydroponics as a deployment route, which is why we later visited Yes Health iFarm on 11 August to understand industrial hydroponic plumbing. The cost is that our plant evidence sits across agar, soil and hydroponic systems, and Prof. Cheng's 28 August return visit told us some earlier results may have reflected unintended handling stress rather than the treatments.
questions.answer_zh: 我們採納鄭教授的意見。3 月 27 日她表示水耕對我們的測試可能不夠穩定，建議先以洋菜膠平板培養取得早期可控性，再小心移植到土壤，並提供我們阿拉伯芥種子；我們因此改用「平板到土壤」的轉移模式，不再把水耕當作主要實驗系統，也把滲透逆境從目標逆境中移除以減少干擾變項。我們並沒有放棄水耕作為「落地部署」的途徑，這也是我們 8 月 11 日參訪源鮮智慧農場、了解工業水耕管線的原因。代價是我們的植物證據橫跨洋菜膠、土壤與水耕三套系統；而鄭教授 8 月 28 日的回訪告訴我們，部分早期結果可能反映的是非預期的操作逆境，而不是處理本身。
questions.trap: Presenting the two pieces of advice as agreeing. They pointed in opposite directions and you must say which one you took.
questions.trap_zh: 把這兩個建議講成一致。它們方向相反，必須說清楚你們採納了哪一個。

questions.q: Give me the booth survey numbers: how many respondents, out of how many visitors, and what did the one tested knowledge question show?
questions.q_zh: 請給我攤位問卷的數字：多少人填答、來訪人數多少、唯一一題測驗型知識題的結果是什麼？
questions.answer: 62 respondents out of 116 people who visited the booth, collected at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market on 5 September across six interactive stations. The one question that tested recall rather than self-report asked which region the map showed as highest plant stress: 32 of 62 (51.6%) correctly said Yilan, with Kaohsiung 12 (19.4%), Taichung 11 (17.7%) and Tainan 7 (11.3%). Self-reported high understanding was 62.9% for climate change impact on agriculture, 66.1% for biotic versus abiotic stress and 69.4% for the ReLeaf device and protectant mechanics.
questions.answer_zh: 攤位來訪共 116 人，其中 62 人填答問卷，2026 年 9 月 5 日在台北水花園有機農夫市集的六個互動站收集。唯一真正測驗記憶（而非自評）的題目是問地圖上哪個地區的植物逆境最高：62 人中有 32 人（51.6%）正確回答宜蘭，高雄 12 人（19.4%）、台中 11 人（17.7%）、台南 7 人（11.3%）。自評「高度理解」的比例為：氣候變遷對農業的影響 62.9%、生物性與非生物性逆境的差別 66.1%、ReLeaf 裝置與保護劑機制 69.4%。
questions.trap: Quoting "over 90% left with a better understanding" as a measured result. That figure is self-rated understanding; the only tested item came out at 51.6%.
questions.trap_zh: 把「超過九成的人理解更深」當成實測結果來引用。那是自評理解度；唯一的測驗題結果是 51.6%。

questions.q: Your forum KAP chart and your forum prose give different numbers for the general public, and the response counts are missing. Walk me through it.
questions.q_zh: 你們論壇 KAP 的圖表和文字敘述對一般民眾給出不同的數字，而且缺少填答人數。請說明一下。
questions.answer: The chart reports the general public at Knowledge 93%, Attitude 100% and Practice 100%; the paragraph immediately below reports 90%, 95% and 100% for the same three questions. We have not reconciled them. The chart caption also states that the number of people who answered in each group is not yet recorded, and our own Open items list carries "the number of forum survey responses per group" as Pending. Without a denominator, a 100% speaker score could rest on three people, so the forum KAP should be read as direction of response, not as a measured effect size. The booth survey, by contrast, has a stated n of 62.
questions.answer_zh: 圖表標示一般民眾的知識 93%、態度 100%、行為 100%；緊接在下方的段落對同樣三題寫的是 90%、95%、100%。我們尚未調和這兩組數字。圖說也明寫各組填答人數仍未記錄，而我們自己的「待辦事項」清單把「論壇問卷各組的回覆份數」列為尚未完成。沒有分母，講者端 100% 的分數可能只建立在三個人身上，因此論壇 KAP 應讀作回應的方向，而不是可測量的效果量。相較之下，攤位問卷有明確的 n = 62。
questions.trap: Quoting whichever set of percentages comes to mind. A judge who has the page open sees both.
questions.trap_zh: 隨口引用其中一組百分比。評審手上打開著頁面，兩組都看得到。

questions.q: How well did the physicalization board actually work without a team member standing next to it?
questions.q_zh: 在沒有組員在旁解說的情況下，資料實體化看板實際上的效果如何？
questions.answer: About half as well as we would like, and the page says so. 32 of 62 respondents (51.6%) correctly read Yilan as the highest-stress region from the LED flashing on a single brief encounter; the Data Physicalization page calls that a reasonable result for a passive booth interaction but also a concrete design target, namely making the LED flashing-to-stress-level mapping more immediately legible so regional differences do not require as much explanation from a team member standing nearby. We also know visitors arrived expecting Taipei to be the most stressed region, so the board was working against a prior. The 95.2% who said the map helped them is a satisfaction measure, not a reading-comprehension measure.
questions.answer_zh: 大約只有我們期望的一半，而頁面本身也這麼寫。62 位填答者中有 32 位（51.6%）在一次短暫接觸中，能從 LED 閃爍正確讀出宜蘭是逆境最高的地區；資料實體化頁稱這對被動式攤位互動而言是合理的結果，但同時也是一個明確的設計目標：讓「LED 閃爍頻率對應逆境強度」更一目了然，使地區差異不必依賴旁邊組員解說。我們也知道來訪者原本預期台北壓力最大，因此看板是在對抗一個先驗印象。那 95.2% 認為地圖有幫助的比例是滿意度，不是閱讀理解度。
questions.trap: Leading with the 95.2% helpfulness figure. The legibility number is the one that bounds the claim.
questions.trap_zh: 先講 95.2% 的有幫助比例。真正界定這個主張邊界的是可讀性那個數字。

questions.q: Why build a styrofoam board with LEDs and play plant sounds, instead of showing the same data as a graph?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼要做保麗龍看板加 LED、還播放植物的聲音，而不是把同樣的資料做成圖表？
questions.answer: Because the thing we needed the public to grasp is invisible, and we were working from a definition rather than a whim: Jansen et al. define a physicalization as a physical artifact whose geometry or material properties encode data. The board encodes two variables at once, coloured paper for crop yield from dark green down to brown and LED flash frequency for stress severity, so a visitor compares outcome against cause in one glance. The sound exhibit is the stronger half of the decision: it plays pitch-shifted recordings of drought-stressed tomato and tobacco from Khait et al. 2023, and in the free-text responses several visitors named the clicking sound, not the map or our explanation, as the most memorable part of the visit. That also validated using natural plant signals to explain our biosensors.
questions.answer_zh: 因為我們希望民眾理解的東西本身是看不見的，而我們是依據一個定義而非一時興起：Jansen 等人將資料實體化定義為「以幾何或材料性質編碼資料的實體物件」。看板同時編碼兩個變項——彩紙代表作物產量，由深綠到褐色；LED 閃爍頻率代表逆境強度——讓來訪者一眼就能把結果與成因對照。聲音展件是這個決定更有力的一半：它播放 Khait 等人 2023 年研究中、經降頻處理的乾旱逆境番茄與菸草錄音；在開放式回答中，有數位來訪者指出最難忘的不是地圖也不是我們的解說，而是那陣咔咔聲。這也驗證了用植物的自然訊號來說明我們的生物感測概念。
questions.trap: Describing it as a decoration for the booth. It is cited to a CHI 2015 definition and it produced the booth's strongest qualitative result.
questions.trap_zh: 把它說成攤位的裝飾。它引用的是 CHI 2015 的定義，而且產出了攤位最強的質性結果。

questions.q: In schools you ran pre- and post-lesson surveys. Why did the forum and booth get a post-event survey only?
questions.q_zh: 在學校你們做了課前與課後問卷。為什麼論壇與攤位只做了事後問卷？
questions.answer: The school programme used a seven-question Kahoot pre-survey before teaching and a KAP post-survey after, which is why Education can show pre-versus-post gains across four trials, including Q4 biotic versus abiotic stress and Q6 DNA codons rising from at or below 25% to around 90%. The forum and the booth were open, drop-in public events with no fixed cohort, and both instruments are post-event KAP self-report built on the WHO KAP guide. The consequence is that we cannot state a change for the public events, only a reported state after them. The one exception is the map question, which tests recall against a right answer, and that is also the lowest number we report.
questions.answer_zh: 學校方案在授課前使用七題 Kahoot 前測，課後再做 KAP 後測，這也是教育頁能呈現四個場次前後對照增幅的原因，包括第 4 題（生物性 vs. 非生物性逆境）與第 6 題（DNA 密碼子）從 25% 或以下提升到約 90%。論壇與攤位是開放式、隨到隨參與的公眾活動，沒有固定受試群體，兩份問卷都是依據 WHO 的 KAP 指南設計的事後自評。後果是我們無法對這兩場公眾活動陳述「變化量」，只能陳述活動後的「狀態」。唯一例外是地圖那一題，它有標準答案、測的是記憶，而那也是我們回報數字中最低的一個。
questions.trap: Describing the booth survey as showing that understanding increased. Without a baseline it shows reported understanding after the event.
questions.trap_zh: 把攤位問卷說成證明理解度提升了。沒有基線，它只能顯示活動後自評的理解狀態。

questions.q: List the farm and company visits with their dates, and say what each one was for.
questions.q_zh: 請列出各次農場與企業參訪的日期，並說明各次的目的。
questions.answer: Taipei Expo Farmers Market, 16 May, interviewing organic smallholders about which stresses hurt them most and their view of technology. CH Biotech (正瀚生技), 9 July, a biostimulant company, on delivery methods, production cost per area, AI screening and Taiwanese regulation; their researcher 袁秋英 gave us the regulatory briefing on the Laws page. Tamsui Happy Farm, 21 July, Ms. Chen, a natural-farming farmer. Yes Health iFarm (源鮮智慧農場), 11 August, industrial hydroponics, environmental monitoring, nutrient management, lighting, aeration and circulation. Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative, an online meeting with founder Mr. Chen. Plus two exhibitions: BIO Asia-Taiwan on 18 July and Taiwan SMART Agriweek on 9 September.
questions.answer_zh: 台北花博農民市集，5 月 16 日，訪談有機小農最受哪些逆境影響、以及他們對農業科技的看法。正瀚生技，7 月 9 日，一家生物刺激素公司，討論施用方式、單位面積生產成本、AI 篩選與台灣法規；他們的研究員袁秋英為我們做了法規頁上的那場法規簡報。淡水幸福農場，7 月 21 日，陳女士，自然農法農友。源鮮智慧農場，8 月 11 日，工業水耕、環境監測、養液管理、照明、曝氣與水循環。蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社，與創辦人陳先生的線上會議。另有兩場展覽：7 月 18 日 BIO Asia-Taiwan 亞洲生技大會、9 月 9 日台灣智慧農業週。
questions.trap: Mixing up the two Prof. Changs — 張嘉修 is bioreactor and hardware (18 June, 4 September), 張弘浩 is agricultural economics and policy at NTU (31 August).
questions.trap_zh: 把兩位張教授搞混——張嘉修負責生物反應器與硬體（6 月 18 日、9 月 4 日），張弘浩是台大農業經濟與政策專家（8 月 31 日）。

questions.q: A natural-farming farmer told you that giving a plant too much takes away its ability to survive on its own. What did you change?
questions.q_zh: 一位自然農法農友告訴你們，給植物太多反而會剝奪它自己生存的能力。你們因此改了什麼？
questions.answer: Ms. Chen at Tamsui Happy Farm, 21 July, is the source and we treat her objection as the main negative against our own project. Two concrete changes: the business plan now constrains how much protectant is released, so the crop is supported without removing its own stress response; and because she told us seeds are lost after typhoons and floods, we built the Seed Exchange Platform into the 農友助手 LINE account, where users post seed supply and demand with variety, harvest year and planting location and are matched. The Sustainability page carries her quote under Potential negatives rather than burying it. Prof. Huang's advice to run the reactor periodically when stress hits, rather than continuously, pushes the same way.
questions.answer_zh: 來源是 7 月 21 日淡水幸福農場的陳女士，我們把她的質疑當作我們專案最主要的負面意見。兩項具體改變：商業計畫現在限制保護劑的釋放量，讓作物獲得支持但不被剝奪自身的逆境反應；另外因為她提到颱風與洪水後種子會流失，我們在「農友助手」LINE 帳號中加入種子交換平台，使用者可張貼種子供需（含品種、採收年份、種植地點）並由系統配對。永續頁把她的引述放在「潛在負面影響」一節，而不是把它埋起來。黃教授建議反應器在逆境來襲時「週期性」而非連續運轉，方向是一致的。
questions.trap: Answering only with the seed platform. The dose constraint is the design change; the platform is the side benefit.
questions.trap_zh: 只回答種子平台。真正的設計改變是劑量限制，平台只是附帶的收穫。

questions.q: You accept that plants on your protectant may fail to build their own resilience. Have you tested that?
questions.q_zh: 你們承認使用你們保護劑的植物可能無法培養自身的耐逆性。這件事你們測過嗎？
questions.answer: No. The Sustainability page states the risk plainly, that plants on our protectant may never grow their own resilience and may succumb more easily once taken off it, and attributes it to Ms. Chen, but no withdrawal or dependency experiment exists anywhere on the wiki. The nearest thing we have is treatment-timing work: experimental set 7 added CH Biotech's commercial peptide at 1/500 dilution one day before, on the same day as, and one day after 75 and 100 mM NaCl, which tests whether a plant can be primed in advance of a forecast. Even our heat work is not priming: the Plants page says we held plates at 37 °C for five days with no challenge and no recovery phase, so it is sustained moderate heat. The honest position is that the dependency objection is acknowledged and unanswered.
questions.answer_zh: 沒有。永續頁明白寫出這個風險——使用我們保護劑的植物可能永遠不會發展自身的耐逆性，一旦停用反而更容易受害——並歸因於陳女士的意見，但 wiki 上沒有任何停用或依賴性實驗。最接近的是施用時機的實驗：第 7 組實驗把正瀚生技的商用胜肽以 1/500 稀釋，分別在 75 與 100 mM NaCl 之前一天、同一天、之後一天加入，用以測試植物能否依預報提前被「預備」(priming)。連我們的熱逆境實驗也不是 priming：植物頁寫明我們把平板置於 37 °C 五天，既沒有挑戰期也沒有恢復期，所以那是持續性的中度熱逆境。誠實的立場是：這項依賴性質疑我們已承認，但尚未回答。
questions.trap: Describing the timing experiment as evidence against dependency. It tests priming timing, not what happens when the protectant is withdrawn.
questions.trap_zh: 把時機實驗說成反駁依賴性的證據。它測的是 priming 的時機，不是停用保護劑後會發生什麼。

questions.q: In Taiwan, what would ReLeaf's cell-free output actually have to be registered as, and under which provisions?
questions.q_zh: 在台灣，ReLeaf 的無細胞產出實際上必須登記為什麼？依據哪些條文？
questions.answer: Our working route is the Fertilizer Management Act (肥料管理法). Article 5 prohibits manufacture, import or sale of a fertilizer without a fertilizer registration certificate, and Article 7 requires the certificate to state the fertilizer category, registered ingredients, physical characteristics, packaging quantity, manufacturer and manufacturing facility. The category we are investigating is Plant Growth Auxiliary Materials (植物生長輔助劑類), one of nine fertilizer categories in Taiwan's published classification. Articles 19 and 20 then govern advertising, requiring the registration number, category and ingredients and prohibiting false or exaggerated claims. The barrier on the other side is the Pesticide Management Act (農藥管理法): its Article 5 definition reaches products that regulate crop growth or affect plant physiological functions, and if we fell in there Articles 9 and 10 would require registration with physicochemical, toxicological and field-trial data.
questions.answer_zh: 我們設定的路徑是《肥料管理法》。第 5 條規定未取得肥料登記證不得製造、輸入或販賣肥料；第 7 條要求登記證上須記載肥料種類、登記成分、物理性狀、包裝量、製造者與製造場所。我們研究的品目是「植物生長輔助劑類」，為台灣公告肥料分類九大種類之一。第 19、20 條則管理廣告，要求標示登記證號、種類與成分，並禁止虛偽誇大。另一側的障礙是《農藥管理法》：其第 5 條的定義可涵蓋調節作物生長或影響植物生理機能的製劑，一旦落入該範圍，第 9、10 條將要求登記並檢附理化、毒理與田間試驗資料。
questions.trap: Saying ReLeaf is a biostimulant in Taiwan. Our page is explicit that Taiwan has no single dedicated plant-biostimulant framework in the sources we reviewed; biostimulant-like products are handled through more than one pathway.
questions.trap_zh: 說 ReLeaf 在台灣是生物刺激素。我們的頁面明寫：在我們查閱的來源中，台灣沒有單一專屬的植物生物刺激素框架，類似產品是透過多條路徑管理的。

questions.q: You chose the EU as your first international market rather than the US or Southeast Asia. On what evidence?
questions.q_zh: 你們選擇歐盟作為第一個國際市場，而不是美國或東南亞。依據什麼證據？
questions.answer: Because the EU is the only one of the three markets we studied with a category whose stated function matches ours. Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 establishes Product Function Category 6, Plant Biostimulants, split into microbial and non-microbial, and the definition names tolerance to abiotic stress as one of the four characteristics a biostimulant may claim. Our output is cell-free proteins and peptides, so PFC 6(B), non-microbial, is the pathway we investigate, and a CE-marked compliant product reaches the whole single market rather than 27 national systems. The US has no single harmonised federal biostimulant pathway: fertilizer registration is primarily state-level through AAPFCO-based frameworks, and AAPFCO's Uniform Beneficial Substances Model Bill of February 2024 is model legislation, not a federal route. Our sequence is Taiwan, then EU, then Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia.
questions.answer_zh: 因為在我們研究的三個市場中，只有歐盟有一個「宣稱功能」與我們一致的產品類別。歐盟法規 (EU) 2019/1009 設立產品功能類別 (PFC) 6「植物生物刺激素」，分為微生物與非微生物兩類，其定義明確把「非生物逆境耐受性」列為生物刺激素可主張的四項特性之一。我們的產出是無細胞蛋白與胜肽，因此我們研究的是 PFC 6(B)（非微生物）；且取得 CE 標誌的合規產品可進入整個單一市場，而不必面對 27 套國家制度。美國則沒有單一協調的聯邦生物刺激素路徑：肥料登記主要在州層級、依循 AAPFCO 架構，而 AAPFCO 2024 年 2 月通過的《統一有益物質模範法案》只是模範立法，不是聯邦途徑。我們的順序是台灣 → 歐盟 → 菲律賓 → 越南 → 泰國 → 印尼。
questions.trap: Arguing from EU market size. The argument on the page is regulatory fit and harmonisation, not size.
questions.trap_zh: 拿歐盟市場規模當理由。頁面上的論證是法規契合度與協調化，不是規模。

questions.q: If PFC 6(B) fits your function, what still stands between you and the EU market?
questions.q_zh: 如果 PFC 6(B) 符合你們的功能，那你們與歐盟市場之間還隔著什麼？
questions.answer: Four things, and our page is careful that PFC 6(B) is a potential pathway, not an automatic classification. First, Component Material Categories: a product must consist solely of component materials complying with an applicable CMC, and we have not established an applicable CMC for any of our proteins or peptides, so that is an open product-development question. Second, the claimed function must be supported by mode of action or relative content, so our own efficacy data has to carry the salinity and drought claims, and our page lists efficacy data for label claims as still under development. Third, safety, quality and batch consistency, including identity, concentration, purity, stability and microbial contamination. Fourth, conformity assessment, an EU Declaration of Conformity and CE marking. The bioreactor is a separate CE question under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC until 20 January 2027 and Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 after it, plus Low Voltage and EMC, and possibly pressure equipment depending on final ratings.
questions.answer_zh: 還有四件事，而我們的頁面很謹慎地把 PFC 6(B) 稱為「可能的路徑」，不是自動適用的分類。第一是成分材料類別 (CMC)：產品必須完全由符合某一適用 CMC 的成分材料組成，而我們尚未為任何一種蛋白或胜肽確立適用的 CMC，這仍是未決的產品開發問題。第二，所宣稱的功能必須由作用機制或成分相對含量支持，因此我們自己的效能資料必須撐起鹽逆境與乾旱的主張，而我們的頁面把「標示主張所需的效能資料」列為仍在發展中。第三是安全、品質與批次一致性，包括同一性、濃度、純度、穩定性與微生物污染。第四是符合性評鑑、歐盟符合性聲明與 CE 標誌。生物反應器則是另一個獨立的 CE 問題：2027 年 1 月 20 日前適用機械指令 2006/42/EC，之後適用法規 (EU) 2023/1230，另加低電壓與電磁相容指令，並視最終規格可能涉及壓力設備指令。
questions.trap: Treating PFC 6(B) as approval. PFC answers what the product does; CMC answers what it is made from, and we have not answered the second.
questions.trap_zh: 把 PFC 6(B) 當成核准。PFC 回答產品「做什麼」，CMC 回答產品「由什麼構成」，而第二個我們還沒回答。

questions.q: Your Entrepreneurship page says you would obtain "absolute containment" certification in Taiwan and reach market in about 30 days, with redundant genetic kill switches. Your Laws page says the opposite. Which do you stand behind?
questions.q_zh: 你們的商業化頁說會在台灣取得「絕對圍阻」認證、約 30 天進入市場，還有冗餘的基因自殺開關。你們的法規頁說法相反。你們支持哪一個？
questions.answer: The Laws and Regulations page, which is the researched version, and the Entrepreneurship page needs correcting. Laws states that we identified no general Taiwan contained-use GMO rule that clearly applies to our engineered B. subtilis production chassis, that we therefore treat the Taiwan status of the production strain as unconfirmed, and that MOA has not confirmed that a ReLeaf protein or peptide fits the plant-growth-auxiliary-material category or any other fertilizer category. Entrepreneurship instead asserts a contained-use classification, a roughly 20 plus 7 day path to market, an "absolute containment" certification, and registering LEA14 and ACCD as plant growth regulators, which is exactly the positioning Laws tells us to avoid because Taiwan's pesticide definition reaches preparations that regulate crop growth. It also claims redundant CRISPR kill switches and a 0.22 µm membrane, where Safety describes no genetic containment and every other page gives 0.2 µm. Nothing supports the 30-day figure.
questions.answer_zh: 我們支持《法規》頁，那是經過研究的版本；商業化頁需要修正。法規頁寫明：我們未找到任何明確適用於我們工程化枯草桿菌生產底盤的台灣一般性密閉使用 GMO 規定，因此我們把生產菌株在台灣的法規地位視為「未確認」；而農業部也尚未確認 ReLeaf 的任何蛋白或胜肽符合植物生長輔助劑類或其他任何肥料品目。商業化頁卻斷言已有密閉使用分類、約 20 + 7 天的上市路徑、一張「絕對圍阻」認證，以及把 LEA14 與 ACCD 登記為植物生長調節劑——而這正是法規頁要我們避免的定位，因為台灣農藥的定義涵蓋調節作物生長的製劑。該頁還聲稱有冗餘的 CRISPR 自殺開關與 0.22 µm 的膜，但安全頁完全沒有描述任何基因圍阻，其他頁面一律寫 0.2 µm。那個 30 天的數字沒有任何依據。
questions.trap: Defending the 30-day timeline or the kill switches because they are on the wiki. The Laws page's "What is still unconfirmed?" list contradicts both.
questions.trap_zh: 因為 wiki 上有寫就去辯護 30 天時程或自殺開關。法規頁「尚未確認的事項」清單把兩者都否掉了。

questions.q: The engineered production strain is a separate regulatory object from the output. What is its status in Taiwan and in the US?
questions.q_zh: 工程化生產菌株在法規上與產出是不同的對象。它在台灣與美國的地位分別是什麼？
questions.answer: In Taiwan, unconfirmed. We identified no general contained-use GMO statute in the agricultural regulations we reviewed that governs an engineered bacterial production chassis of this type; MOA has specific rules for transgenic plants, and GM microorganisms appear in sector-specific rules such as the Feed Control Act when used as feed, and neither framework describes our system. We would seek a written determination covering the microorganism, contained production, transport of the culture and waste handling before commercial manufacture. In the US, the framework we identified is EPA's regulation of certain intergeneric microorganisms under TSCA Section 5, implemented through 40 C.F.R. Part 725; B. subtilis is listed as a recipient microorganism eligible for the tiered exemptions in §725.420, but whether our final strain qualifies for a Tier I or Tier II exemption depends on the introduced genetic material and the required containment measures, and containment alone does not create an exemption. USDA-APHIS 7 C.F.R. Part 340 is not the primary pathway because it concerns plant pests and regulated articles.
questions.answer_zh: 在台灣是「未確認」。在我們查閱的農業法規中，沒有找到任何一般性密閉使用 GMO 法規在規範此類工程化細菌生產底盤；農業部對基因轉殖植物有專門規定，基因改造微生物則出現在《飼料管理法》等特定領域規範中（當其作為飼料使用時），兩者都沒有描述我們的系統。商業化製造前，我們會就該微生物、密閉生產、菌液運輸與廢棄物處理尋求書面認定。在美國，我們辨識出的框架是 EPA 依《有毒物質管制法》(TSCA) 第 5 條、透過 40 C.F.R. Part 725 對特定跨屬微生物的管理；枯草桿菌被列為 §725.420 分級豁免的合格受體微生物，但我們最終菌株是否符合 Tier I 或 Tier II 豁免，取決於所導入的遺傳物質與所要求的圍阻措施，而且單靠圍阻並不構成豁免。USDA-APHIS 的 7 C.F.R. Part 340 不是主要路徑，因為它處理的是植物有害生物與受管制物品。
questions.trap: Saying the strain is covered because it never leaves the device. Containment is an engineering and risk-management requirement; it does not supply a legal classification.
questions.trap_zh: 說菌株因為從不離開裝置所以已被涵蓋。圍阻是工程與風險管理上的要求，它本身不提供法律分類。

questions.q: Why not just apply the engineered bacteria to the crop directly, as a PGPR product? That was your original plan.
questions.q_zh: 為什麼不直接把工程菌作為 PGPR 產品施用到作物上？那原本就是你們的計畫。
questions.answer: Because direct application makes the engineered organism itself the agricultural product, which introduces substantially different questions about environmental exposure and organism release, and our current design intentionally avoids it by keeping the organism in the bioreactor and delivering a cell-free output. The experts drove this: Prof. Chen on 10 April pointed out the problems of open-soil release, and Dr. Brophy on 18 April put physical containment first. The World Vegetable Center on 22 May also told us we would need more regulatory research on GMO use to show it would not harm the environment. One honest caveat: the Laws page table that compares pathways has the Direct Application row only partly filled in, with two cells reading "Not written yet", and the Organic-Agriculture Positioning row almost empty, so the written comparison is thinner than the decision behind it.
questions.answer_zh: 因為直接施用會讓工程生物本身成為農業產品，這會引入關於環境暴露與生物釋放的、性質截然不同的問題；而我們現在的設計刻意避開它——把生物留在生物反應器內，輸出無細胞產物。這是專家推動的：4 月 10 日陳教授指出土壤開放釋放的問題，4 月 18 日 Dr. Brophy 把物理圍阻放在第一位。5 月 22 日世界蔬菜中心也告訴我們，必須做更多 GMO 使用的法規研究，以證明不會危害環境。一個誠實的附帶說明：法規頁比較各路徑的表格中，「直接施用工程細菌」那一列只填了一部分，有兩格寫著「尚未撰寫」，而「有機農業定位」那一列幾乎是空的，所以書面比較比背後的決策單薄。
questions.trap: Claiming the comparison table rules the route out on regulatory grounds. Two of its cells are blank; the decision rests on the April expert advice.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱比較表已從法規角度排除該路徑。表中有兩格是空的；決策依據是四月的專家建議。

questions.q: Most of the farmers you met are organic or natural-farming growers. Can they use ReLeaf?
questions.q_zh: 你們接觸的農友多數是有機或自然農法的生產者。他們可以使用 ReLeaf 嗎？
questions.answer: Not initially, and we say so. Taiwan's Organic Agriculture Promotion Act (有機農業促進法) defines organic agriculture in a way that excludes GMOs and their products, and Taiwan's organic production standards prohibit genetically modified biological preparations and materials. Because our production platform is an engineered microorganism, we should not position the system as an input for certified organic production without first obtaining a specific regulatory determination that the cell-free output is permitted. The initial Taiwan market is therefore conventional agriculture and sustainable-input applications, where the value proposition is reducing chemical inputs. This is awkward because a farmer at the forum asked exactly this, whether organic certification is required when using our bioreactor, and that question is still on our Open items list as unanswered.
questions.answer_zh: 初期不行，而我們也這麼說明。台灣《有機農業促進法》對有機農業的定義排除基因改造生物及其產品，台灣的有機生產規範也禁止使用基因改造生物製劑與材料。由於我們的生產平台是工程化微生物，在未取得「無細胞產出可被允許」的特定法規認定之前，我們不應把這套系統定位為驗證有機生產的投入品。因此台灣初期市場是常規農業與永續投入應用，價值主張是減少化學投入。這一點很尷尬，因為論壇上就有農友問了完全相同的問題——使用你們的生物反應器是否還需要有機驗證——而這個問題至今仍列在我們的待辦清單上未被回答。
questions.trap: Answering that the output is natural so organic farms can use it. Organic standards turn on the production platform, not only on the final molecule.
questions.trap_zh: 回答「產出是天然的，所以有機農場可以用」。有機規範看的是生產平台，而不只是最終分子。

questions.q: Farmers asked you two questions at your own forum. Have you answered them?
questions.q_zh: 在你們自己的論壇上，農友問了兩個問題。你們回答了嗎？
questions.answer: Not yet, and both are listed as Open on our page. The first was whether organic certification is required when using our bioreactor, which the Laws page answers only partly: organic positioning is excluded for now pending a specific regulatory determination. The second was how many bioreactors one farm needs, which the Entrepreneurship page addresses only as a procedure, consulting on soil variability and then determining how many bioreactors and sensors the intended area needs, with no sizing rule, no coverage area per unit and no worked example. These were the two questions the people we are building for actually asked, so leaving them open is the gap a judge should press on.
questions.answer_zh: 尚未回答，兩題在我們頁面上都列為「未結案」。第一題是使用我們的生物反應器是否需要有機驗證；法規頁只回答了一半：在取得特定法規認定前，暫時排除有機定位。第二題是一座農場需要幾台生物反應器；商業化頁只以流程回應——先會勘土壤差異，再決定目標面積需要幾台反應器與感測器——沒有任何估算規則、沒有單機覆蓋面積、也沒有實際算例。這兩題是我們服務對象真正提出的問題，因此擱置不答正是評審該追問的缺口。
questions.trap: Improvising a number of bioreactors per hectare. No such figure exists on the wiki.
questions.trap_zh: 臨場編一個每公頃幾台反應器的數字。wiki 上沒有這個數字。

questions.q: Your containment story includes the light switch: bacteria only make protectant when the green light is on. How much of that is shown?
questions.q_zh: 你們的圍阻論述包含光開關：只有綠光開啟時細菌才製造保護劑。這部分有多少是已經證明的？
questions.answer: None of it, as a measurement. Results states flatly that no induction curve exists, that nothing anywhere in the project shows PcpcG2 output changing with green light, and that the DiOPAL array has never run a CcaS/CcaR experiment on a live culture, so no dose, duration or intensity has ever been paired with an expression readout. Every statement about the light switch on the wiki, including the optogenetic kinetics simulated on Math Model, is design intent carried forward from the Castillo-Hair CcaSR literature. So "the switch limits production" is a design claim, and containment of the organism rests on the membrane alone, not on the circuit. Results names this induction curve as the single experiment that would move the project furthest.
questions.answer_zh: 就「量測」而言，完全沒有。Results 頁直截了當地寫明：不存在誘導曲線，專案中沒有任何地方顯示 PcpcG2 的輸出隨綠光改變，而 DiOPAL 燈陣從未對活菌培養執行過 CcaS/CcaR 實驗，因此從未有任何劑量、時長或強度與表現量讀值配對。wiki 上關於光開關的所有陳述，包括數學模型頁上模擬的光遺傳動力學，都是從 Castillo-Hair 的 CcaSR 文獻延伸而來的設計意圖。因此「開關限制產量」是設計主張，而生物體的圍阻只靠膜，不靠迴路。Results 頁也指出，這條誘導曲線是最能推進整個專案的單一實驗。
questions.trap: Saying the circuit is a second layer of biosafety. Without an induction curve it is not a layer of anything yet.
questions.trap_zh: 說這個迴路是第二層生物安全。沒有誘導曲線，它目前還不構成任何一層。

questions.q: At BIO Asia-Taiwan you were told to consider delivering through the existing irrigation system instead of a standalone device. Did you take that route?
questions.q_zh: 在亞洲生技大會上，有人建議你們改用既有灌溉系統輸送，而不是獨立裝置。你們採納了嗎？
questions.answer: Partly. The 18 July exhibition takeaway was to investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device, and we kept both: the design now delivers through hydroponic circulation or soil irrigation rather than spraying from the machine itself, and Prof. Chang's 4 September advice pushed us further toward a modular, farmer-friendly replaceable bacterial capsule. We did not give up the device, because the whole point of on-site production is avoiding shelf life and transport cost, and because the containment argument needs a vessel the culture stays inside. The same exhibition visit also produced two changes we did act on directly: prioritising a dissolved-oxygen sensor and feedback loop, and moving at least some validation from agar and hydroponics to soil trials with a larger sample size.
questions.answer_zh: 部分採納。7 月 18 日展覽的收穫是「研究以灌溉系統整合輸送作為獨立裝置的替代方案」，而我們兩者都保留了：現在的設計是透過水耕循環或土壤灌溉輸送，而不是由機器本身噴灑；張嘉修教授 9 月 4 日的建議又把我們更推向模組化、對農友友善的可更換菌液匣。我們沒有放棄裝置，因為現地生產的重點就是避開保存期限與運輸成本，而且圍阻論證需要一個讓菌液留在其中的容器。同一次參展還直接促成兩項我們確實執行的改變：優先配置溶氧 (DO) 感測器與回饋迴路，以及把至少部分驗證實驗從洋菜膠與水耕移到土壤試驗並擴大樣本數。
questions.trap: Describing the standalone device and irrigation delivery as competing. The device produces; the irrigation system distributes. Both are in the current design.
questions.trap_zh: 把獨立裝置與灌溉輸送說成互斥。裝置負責生產，灌溉系統負責分配，現行設計兩者都有。

questions.q: Why do you refuse to make pest-control claims, even though you also talk about biotic stress?
questions.q_zh: 既然你們也談生物性逆境，為什麼拒絕做防治病蟲害的主張？
questions.answer: Because the claim, not the molecule, decides the regulatory category, and a pesticidal claim moves us into the hardest pathway in every market we studied. Taiwan's Pesticide Management Act Article 5 reaches products that control harmful organisms and products that regulate crop growth or affect plant physiological functions, so we keep claims to abiotic-stress tolerance: BoPep4 and ACCD for salinity, AtLEA14 for drought. In the US, EPA defines plant regulators within the pesticide framework under FIFRA, and the exemptions in 40 C.F.R. §152.6 cannot be assumed merely because we call the product a biostimulant. In the EU the claimed PFC function must be supported by mode of action. The discipline runs the other way too: if we claim improved salinity tolerance, our own plant data has to support that claim, which is why regulatory research feeds back into the plant assays.
questions.answer_zh: 因為決定法規類別的是「主張」而不是分子本身，而病蟲害防治的主張會把我們推進我們研究過的每個市場中最艱難的路徑。台灣《農藥管理法》第 5 條涵蓋防治有害生物的產品，也涵蓋調節作物生長或影響植物生理機能的產品，所以我們把主張限制在非生物逆境耐受性：BoPep4 與 ACCD 對應鹽逆境、AtLEA14 對應乾旱。在美國，EPA 在 FIFRA 架構下把植物調節劑納入農藥範圍，而 40 C.F.R. §152.6 的豁免不能僅因我們自稱生物刺激素就當然適用。在歐盟，所主張的 PFC 功能必須由作用機制支持。這個紀律也反向作用：如果我們主張提升鹽逆境耐受性，我們自己的植物資料就必須支持該主張，這也是法規研究回饋到植物試驗的原因。
questions.trap: Saying biotic stress is out of scope. Farmers at the 16 May market named biotic stress more often than abiotic, and the project widened to include it; what is out of scope is the pesticidal claim.
questions.trap_zh: 說生物性逆境不在範圍內。5 月 16 日市集的農友提到生物性逆境的次數多於非生物性，專案也因此擴大納入；不在範圍內的是「農藥式的主張」。

questions.q: You claim continuous engagement rather than one-off meetings. Name the loops and their dates.
questions.q_zh: 你們主張是持續性的交流而非一次性會面。請列出這些回訪迴圈及其日期。
questions.answer: Four are documented as cards: Prof. Chen Wen-Liang, 10 April to 20 June, who also returned a third time on 5 September as a forum speaker; Prof. Cheng Mei-Jun, 27 March to 28 August; Prof. Chang Jia-xiu (張嘉修), 18 June to 4 September; and Dr. Elizabeth Sattely, 27 June to 12 September, the return meeting joined by Prof. Drew Endy. Each return was driven by something new we brought: updated bioreactor plans and a preliminary model for Prof. Chen, Arabidopsis growth data and the plate-to-soil model for Prof. Cheng, the physical reactor and the passive membrane leak for Prof. Chang, and purified-protectant assays and ACCD mechanism for Dr. Sattely. Prof. Huang (黃介辰) is the fifth, met online on 28 July and in person at NCHU on 6 August, and he then invited us to the 2nd ISLSDR symposium where we presented a poster on 11 September.
questions.answer_zh: 有四組以卡片形式記錄：陳文亮教授，4 月 10 日到 6 月 20 日，他並於 9 月 5 日以論壇講者身分第三次與我們互動；鄭梅君教授，3 月 27 日到 8 月 28 日；張嘉修教授，6 月 18 日到 9 月 4 日；以及 Dr. Elizabeth Sattely，6 月 27 日到 9 月 12 日，回訪時由 Prof. Drew Endy 一同參與。每次回訪都由我們帶去的新東西驅動：對陳教授是更新的反應器規劃與初步數學模型，對鄭教授是阿拉伯芥生長資料與平板到土壤模式，對張教授是實體反應器與膜的被動洩漏問題，對 Sattely 博士是純化保護劑試驗與 ACCD 機制。第五位是黃介辰教授，7 月 28 日線上會議、8 月 6 日赴中興大學面談，他隨後邀請我們參加第二屆 ISLSDR 研討會，我們於 9 月 11 日發表海報。
questions.trap: Saying "five core experts" and then listing only four. The page says five and shows four cards; Prof. Huang is the fifth and has no card.
questions.trap_zh: 說「五位核心專家」卻只列出四位。頁面寫五位、但只有四張卡片；黃教授是第五位，卻沒有卡片。

questions.q: Prof. Huang suggested running the reactor periodically when stress hits rather than continuously. Which did you build?
questions.q_zh: 黃教授建議反應器在逆境來襲時週期性運轉，而非連續運轉。你們做的是哪一種？
questions.answer: We built and ran it continuously, and recorded the periodic option as a strategy to consider rather than one we implemented. On 28 July Prof. Huang advised setting the bioreactor to clear free radicals periodically when stress hits rather than running continuously, and to combine pH and moisture sensors with weather forecasting and AI to release protectants early; he also said biostimulants work best applied at the seedling stage. The reactor evidence we have is continuous perfusion, including a 102.4 h uninterrupted run. We cannot choose between duty cycles anyway, because that choice needs the induction curve we do not have: without knowing how output responds to green-light dose and duration, there is no basis for a periodic schedule. Dr. Lin's 19 March advice did move us to seedling-stage testing.
questions.answer_zh: 我們建造並以連續模式運轉，週期性運轉只被記錄為「待考慮的策略」，而非已實作的方案。7 月 28 日黃教授建議把生物反應器設定為在逆境來襲時週期性清除自由基，而非持續運轉，並結合 pH 與濕度感測器、天氣預報與 AI 來提早釋放保護劑；他也提到生物刺激素在苗期施用效果最好。我們現有的反應器證據是連續灌流，包括一次 102.4 小時不中斷的運轉。無論如何我們目前也無法在兩種工作週期之間做選擇，因為這個選擇需要我們還沒有的誘導曲線：不知道產出如何隨綠光劑量與時長變化，就沒有任何依據去排定週期性時程。林博士 3 月 19 日的建議確實讓我們轉向苗期測試。
questions.trap: Presenting periodic operation as the current design. It is listed under what we considered, and it is blocked on the missing induction data.
questions.trap_zh: 把週期性運轉說成現行設計。它被列在「我們考慮過」的項目下，而且卡在缺失的誘導資料上。

questions.q: A cooperative founder told you the bioreactor could be damaged by animals or disasters, or the bacteria deliberately released. Where does your wiki handle that?
questions.q_zh: 一位合作社創辦人告訴你們，生物反應器可能被動物或天災破壞，或細菌被刻意釋放。你們的 wiki 在哪裡處理這件事？
questions.answer: Partly, and the strongest version is not on the Safety page. Mr. Chen of the Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative raised it and we say we incorporated it into the business plan's threat analysis; the Entrepreneurship risk table does carry a physical containment breach row, housing cracking or being damaged in handling, transport or extended field use, with stress-testing, tamper-evident design, farmer training and return-to-collection-point as mitigations. But the Safety page's dual-use section is written entirely around the laboratory, restricting access to authorised personnel and committing to responsible conduct, and says nothing about a sealed unit sitting in a field where it can be opened, which is the actual dual-use surface of a deployed product. The Entrepreneurship mitigation also leans on redundancy with genetic containment, which does not exist. So the field threat model is recorded in the business plan and missing from the biosafety page.
questions.answer_zh: 有部分處理，而最有力的版本並不在安全頁上。蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社的陳先生提出此問題，我們也說已把它納入商業計畫的威脅分析；商業化頁的風險表確實有「物理圍阻破損」一列——外殼在搬運、運送或長期田間使用中破裂或受損——並以耐用性測試、防拆顯示設計、農友訓練與回收點回收作為緩解措施。但安全頁的雙重用途 (DURC) 一節完全以實驗室為中心撰寫，內容是限制授權人員存取與承諾負責任的研究行為，對於一台放在田裡、可能被打開的密閉裝置則完全沒有提及，而那正是已部署產品真正的雙重用途暴露面。商業化頁的緩解措施還依賴「與基因圍阻形成冗餘」，而那並不存在。因此田間威脅模型記在商業計畫裡，卻在生物安全頁上缺席。
questions.trap: Answering that DURC is covered. The DURC section covers lab access only; the field unit is not in it.
questions.trap_zh: 回答 DURC 已經涵蓋。該節只涵蓋實驗室存取管制，田間裝置並不在其中。

questions.q: Your Human Practices page says three farmer outreach events from May to August, but lists four, one of them in September. How much of this page can a judge trust as a record?
questions.q_zh: 你們的人文實踐頁說五月到八月辦了三場農友外展活動，卻列出四場，其中一場在九月。評審能把這一頁當作多可靠的紀錄？
questions.answer: The substance is solid and the bookkeeping is not, and we should fix the bookkeeping rather than defend it. The Farmer interviews section says three outreach events from May to August and then carries four: Farmer Expo 16 May, Tamsui Happy Farm 21 July, Water Garden, and the Lanyang River cooperative, which has no date at all. The Water Garden event is dated 6 September in that section and 5 September everywhere else on the page. The page also says five core experts and shows four continuous-engagement cards. And the Project Evolution Map states in its own caption that black text is the team's own record while orange text is a drafted summary, so part of the map is not yet verified team writing. None of this changes which conversation produced which design change, each of which is dated in the pipelines, but a judge checking two numbers in a row will find both wrong.
questions.answer_zh: 內容本身是紮實的，帳目不是；我們應該修正帳目而不是為它辯護。「農友訪談」一節說五月到八月有三場外展活動，接著卻列了四場：5 月 16 日花博農民市集、7 月 21 日淡水幸福農場、水花園，以及完全沒有日期的蘭陽溪合作社。水花園那場在該節寫 9 月 6 日，但頁面其他所有地方都是 9 月 5 日。該頁也說「五位核心專家」，卻只呈現四張持續交流卡片。此外，專案演進地圖在自己的圖說中聲明：黑色文字是團隊自己的紀錄，橘色文字是草擬的摘要，因此地圖有一部分還不是經過核實的團隊撰述。這些都不改變「哪一次對談造成哪一項設計改變」——那些在 pipeline 裡都有日期——但評審若連查兩個數字，會發現兩個都錯。
questions.trap: Defending the "three outreach events" count. Four are described, and the orange text on the evolution map is flagged as drafted, not verified.
questions.trap_zh: 為「三場外展活動」這個數字辯護。頁面描述了四場，而演進地圖上的橘色文字已被標示為草稿、未經核實。
